text: RESOLVED: generic persisted values use conditional VersionedCodec instances. Timeline[A], Trials[K,M,A], Construal[C,E,R], selectors, and generic plan parameters are serializable only when each user-supplied type has a versioned schema codec; typed extension registration captures those instances and runtime loading reports missing schema id/version as data. Generic maps encode as arrays of entries and reject duplicate keys rather than coercing keys to JSON object strings. Large payloads remain typed content-hash artifact references. The exact plan/codec module dependency direction is a blocking v0.5/v0.65 design task and must be resolved before NodeDef[P] implementation. Rationale: APP-5's concrete codec list did not explain arbitrary K/M/A, so serializable typed extensions otherwise relied on an unstated capability.
